name: File Lister
description: List files matching a glob from any fsspec location (S3, GCS, ADLS, local) into a DataFrame of paths, optionally downloading each to a local cache.

outputs.description: DataFrame with one row per matched file: path, local_path, filename, size, modified_at

path.label: Path / Glob
path.description: Glob pattern or fsspec URI to list, e.g. 's3://my-bucket/invoices/**/*.pdf', 'gs://my-bucket/audio/*.wav', 'abfss://container@account.dfs.core.windows.net/docs/*.png', or a local path like '/data/incoming/*.pdf'.

download.label: Download Files
download.description: Download each matched file to a local cache directory and populate local_path. Set false to list metadata only.

download_dir.label: Download Directory
download_dir.description: Local directory to cache downloaded files in. Auto-generated under the system temp dir if unset.

max_files.label: Max Files
max_files.description: Safety cap on how many matched files to list/download in one materialize. Unset means no cap.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses, e.g. ['team:analytics', 'user@company.com']

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset, e.g. {'domain': 'finance', 'tier': 'gold'}

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from the path's protocol if not set.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5'.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (first rows as markdown table).

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when include_preview_metadata is True.

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream columns it derives from.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this asset depends on

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values; 'multi' for date × static. Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_static_dim.label: Partition Static Dim
partition_static_dim.description: Dimension name for the static axis in multi-partitioning.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
